phase_prompt.label: The Oath on Hermon
phase_prompt.summary: Semyaza stands as the hesitant commander on the peak, binding the Watchers to the fatal code injection.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Cinematic wide shot of Semyaza standing at the edge of a high mountain cliff at night. He is a dark, silhouette-like figure with skin like polished black stone. He is surrounded by a circle of 200 faint, ghostly figures. He holds a hand up, generating a floating manifest of glowing red code. The sky above is a visible grid of stars, emphasizing the simulation dome. The lighting is low-key, high-contrast, emphasizing the texture of his futuristic, glass-like clothing. Hyper-realistic, dramatic, sorrowful atmosphere.
